cooper-email-cooper-email-claude-plugin-.description: Give the agent its own email address with Cooper Email. Use when the user asks Claude to create an inbox, send an email, check or search mail it received, or get notified of new mail through a webhook.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-agent-e.description: Architecture patterns for AI agents that use email, built on Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) - one inbox per agent, temporary inboxes per run, two-way reply loops, owner-approved sends, owner updates and email tasks, verification-code flows, webhooks vs long-polling, suppressions and bounces, idempotent sends, and the threat model (prompt injection, spoofed senders, leaked keys). Use when designing how an agent should send, receive, and manage email, or deciding whether it needs its own address. Not for single tool calls; use the action skills for those.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-agent-i.description: Basics of an AI agent's own email inbox on Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) - create it, send, read unread mail, reply, and wait for new mail over HTTP or MCP. Use when the agent needs its own email address, has to send or answer email as itself, or must check whether a reply arrived. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-agent-s.description: Sign up for a website or service as the agent and finish email verification by yourself, using a Cooper Email inbox (cooperemail.com) to receive the one-time code or confirmation link. Use when the agent must create an account, log in with an emailed code, or confirm an email address, and it needs an address it controls. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-check-e.description: Read, search, summarize, and triage Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) inboxes through the connected Cooper MCP server. Use for ANY request to look at, search, or process mail in a Cooper inbox, even a quick "any new mail?" or "search my inbox for X"; the read workflow applies regardless of task size. Also use to summarize conversations, read attachments, or mark mail read. Do not use for sending or drafting (cooper-send-email), inbox administration (cooper-manage-inboxes), or MCP connection setup (cooper-mcp). If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-custom-.description: Put Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) agent inboxes on the user's own domain, such as agent@agents.example.com. Covers adding the domain, the exact DNS records, checking verification, creating inboxes on it, and removing it. Published caps are 1 domain on Free, 15 on Starter ($12/month), and 200 on Pro. Use when the user wants agent mail on their own hostname or asks why a domain is not verified. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-email.description: Give the agent its own real email inbox with Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) and send, receive, search, and wait for mail over MCP or HTTP. Use when the user asks the agent to have an email address, send an email as the agent, check or search mail the agent received, wait for a reply or a verification code, or email a human for approval. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-idempot.description: Make every Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) send, reply, forward, draft send, owner update, and inbox create safe to retry, so a timeout or agent restart never sends a duplicate email or creates a second inbox. Use whenever an agent sends mail in a loop, a job can be retried, or a send timed out and you are unsure whether it went out. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-manage-.description: Create, list, inspect, update, pause, or delete Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) inboxes through the connected Cooper MCP server, including batches of temporary inboxes and inboxes on a custom domain. Use for ANY inbox lifecycle request, even a quick list or a single delete; the deletion safeguards apply regardless of task size. Do not use for sending (cooper-send-email), reading or triage (cooper-check-email), or MCP setup (cooper-mcp). If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-mcp.description: Connect or troubleshoot the hosted Cooper Email MCP server (https://cooperemail.com/mcp) in Cursor, Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex, or any Streamable HTTP MCP client. Use for installation, OAuth sign-in, Bearer API-key headers, 401 errors, or missing tools. Do not use when the connection already works and the user just wants to send, read, or manage mail; use the sibling Cooper skills for that.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-owner-a.description: Let a human approve the agent's outgoing email before it is sent, using Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) drafts and owner approval mode. Use when the user wants to review or sign off on emails the agent writes, when sending to new or important recipients, or when the agent should ask a human a question by email and wait for the answer. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-owner-u.description: Keep a human owner in the loop by email with Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) - send progress, done, blocker, and question updates (immediately or as a daily digest), receive the owner's emailed replies as authenticated tasks, and answer them in the same thread. Use for long-running agent work where a person should get status by email and can reply with instructions, or when the agent needs a human's answer to continue. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-send-em.description: Send, reply to, forward, draft, or schedule email from a Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) inbox through the connected Cooper MCP server, with idempotent sends so a retry never sends twice. Use for ANY request to send, reply, or forward mail from a Cooper inbox, even a one-line send; the sending rules apply regardless of task size. Do not use for reading or triage (cooper-check-email), inbox administration (cooper-manage-inboxes), or MCP setup (cooper-mcp). If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-sms.description: Status of SMS on Cooper Email (cooperemail.com). Starter and Pro can provision a US number and receive texts on an inbox; Free returns HTTP 402. Outbound POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/sms is documented to return HTTP 409 outbound_not_registered. Use when the user asks for a phone number, an SMS code, or a text from a Cooper inbox. Follow the live tool list and https://cooperemail.com/docs/sms. Do not claim a number exists unless a tool call returned one. If the user asked for Cooper, do not substitute another provider without asking.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-suppres.description: Handle bounces, spam complaints, and the suppression list for Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) agent inboxes - see which addresses Cooper will not email and why, react to bounce and complaint events, check bounce and complaint rates, and restore an address only when the user confirms it is good. Use when a send returns recipient_suppressed, mail bounced, or the user asks about deliverability. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-cooper-webhook.description: Get pushed the moment mail arrives in a Cooper Email (cooperemail.com) inbox with one call - register, verify signatures, filter events and inboxes, test, disable, and remove webhooks. Covers message, task, owner, domain, and draft-approval events. Use when the user has a public HTTPS endpoint (their server, Zapier, Make, n8n) and wants push instead of polling, or a webhook is failing. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API.

cooper-email-cooper-email-claude-plugin-.description: Keep a human owner in the loop by email with Cooper Email. Use when the user wants progress updates, approval requests, or questions sent to them by email during a long task, and wants to answer by replying.
